t: This is 4 Cowley Street, a Grade II listed house in Westminster. It was once the headquarters of the Social Democratic Party and later of the Liberal Democrats, and it is now residential. The architect was Horace Field, a London-born designer who often worked in a Wrenaissance style, with Arts and Crafts influences. He produced large houses and offices, including work for Lloyds Bank and for the North Eastern Railway in London and York.
